title: cereus setosus
intro: Cereus setosus, commonly known as the Old Lady Cactus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the Cactaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cereus setosus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and possess anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
